name: Remote ACPX
description: ACP runtime backend dispatching to a paired node via WebSocket, with LLM-invocable run_coder tool.

agentCommand.description: Command on the paired node that dispatches ACP agents. Defaults to 'acpx', which routes to per-variant CLIs (e.g. 'gemini --acp' for variant 'gemini').

defaultAgent.description: ACP agent variant used when run_coder is called without an explicit 'agent'. Recognized variants: 'claude', 'codex', 'gemini'. Other strings pass through to acpx unchanged. Selecting 'gemini' requires the paired node to have completed 'gemini auth login'.

maxOutputChars.description: Max characters in the message section returned to the outer LLM.
